## Reviews of competitor products by the most similar people
[HubSpot CRM]
Role: Community Health worker
Industry: Hospital & Health Care
Company size: 201-500 employees
Time used: 1-2 years
Overall rating: 4
Ease-of-use rating: 3
Pros: Hubspot is very effective for lead management and follow up. Our team is grateful for the cohesive tools it provides.
Cons: Hubspot could be much more clear about how leads get generated, and how to spend our money effectively in order to get more leads for our money. Their logistics are the weakest part of their software.
Comments: Hubspot is great for managing leads amongst a team and following up with potential clients, but it creates poor statistical output and it is easy to feel uninformed.
